billing_unit_warning.why: The published '5-30 credits per message' band is per USER TURN. One turn drives a median of 5 and a mean of 11.8 model requests. Pricing per token_count event understates cost by roughly an order of magnitude.

measured_2026_08_25.corpus: 26 local rollout sessions, 1148 token_count events, 223 user messages

reconciliation_invariant.on_violation: Violations cluster at compaction/resume boundaries where context is rebuilt. Count them and surface the count; do not silently reconcile.
